title: Hiring for Experienced SAP ABAP Technical Consultant in Bengaluru
description:
**Job Title:** SAP ABAP Consultant

**Location: Bangalore/Pune (WFO)**

**Experience:** 3 \+ years

**Employment Type:** Full Time

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain custom SAP ABAP programs including Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms (RICEF).
* Develop and consume RESTful APIs, OData services, and other web services to integrate SAP with third\-party systems.
* Work on SAP NetWeaver Gateway for OData service development and SAP Fiori integration.
* Analyse business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Perform system analysis, coding, testing, debugging, and documentation.
* Optimize existing ABAP code and ensure high performance and scalability.
* Collaborate with functional consultants, business users, and other stakeholders to deliver robust SAP solutions.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data integration and API connectivity.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong hands\-on experience in **SAP ABAP** (Core ABAP, CDS View, AMDP, Reports, BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, Enhancements).
* Experience with **API Integration**: REST, JSON, SOAP, XML, OData, RFC, IDoc.
* Proficiency in **SAP NetWeaver Gateway** and **OData service development**.
* Experience in **SAP Fiori/UI5** integration is a plus.
* Knowledge of **SAP PI/PO or SAP CPI** is an added advantage.
* Understanding of **Authorization and Authentication mechanisms** (OAuth, SAML) for API security.
* Strong debugging and performance optimization skills.
* Good communication and documentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* SAP ABAP Certification (preferred but not mandatory).
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

**Company Overview:ITEOs LLP \- We are IT software company, which is primarily into Application development, developing and providing services into auxiliary services, management consulting, CXO Advisory, etc. Technologies expertise on SAP, Microsoft, Oracle suites, Open\-source ERPs, Mobile Apps and other cutting\-edge technologies to optimize usage and enhance business value. ITeos aims to craft value service to customers in area of Information Lifecycle Management, Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Collaboration platform, CRM, Financial service Autom.**

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

title: Hiring for Field RF Test
description:
Field Test Engineer – RF / Anti\-Drone / GNSS Systems

Department Engineering / Testing \& Field Operations

Designation Field Test Engineer

Experience 3–8 Years

Location Field / Customer Sites / Project Locations

Employment Type Full\-Time

Reporting To Manager – Testing / Engineering

1\. Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Field Test Engineer with hands\-on experience in RF detection, RF jamming, Anti\-

Drone systems, GNSS jamming/detection systems, RF Detectors and electronic\-warfare\-related equipment.

The candidate will be responsible for installation, commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, field trials, performance

evaluation and customer\-site support of RF\-based Anti\-Drone, GNSS Jammer, RF Detector and related systems.

The role involves extensive travel to customer locations, operational sites, test ranges and field\-trial locations for

installation, acceptance testing, demonstrations, troubleshooting and evaluation of new equipment.

2\. Key Responsibilities

Installation \& Commissioning

* Install and commission RF Anti\-Drone Jammers, GNSS Jammers, RF Detectors, RF Surveillance and associated

systems at customer and field locations.

* Install RF equipment, antennas, RF cables, power supplies, control units and communication interfaces.
* Verify system configuration, antenna connections, grounding, power supply and communication links.
* Perform system\-level checks after installation and ensure equipment is ready for operation.

Field Testing \& Trials

* Conduct field testing and performance evaluation of RF detection and jamming systems.
* Participate in customer demonstrations, qualification trials, acceptance tests and operational field trials.
* Execute approved test plans and customer requirements.
* Perform RF measurements and verify frequency coverage, signal strength, detection range, jamming effectiveness

and system response.

* Record test results, observations and anomalies and prepare field\-test reports.

Troubleshooting \& Maintenance

* Diagnose and troubleshoot RF systems, antennas, RF cables, power supplies, communication interfaces and control

software.

* Identify hardware, RF and system\-level faults during field deployment.
* Perform fault isolation and coordinate with design, production and engineering teams for corrective action.
* Carry out system reconfiguration, calibration and replacement of faulty modules where required.

Customer \& Field Support

* Travel to customer locations, defence establishments, test ranges and field locations as required.
* Support customer demonstrations and technical presentations during field trials.
* Interact with customer engineering, technical and operational teams.
* Provide on\-site technical support during deployment and operational trials.

New Product Testing

* Participate in testing and evaluation of new RF / Anti\-Drone / GNSS / Detection and Jamming equipment.
* Develop and execute test procedures for new equipment.
* Verify equipment functionality against specifications and requirements.
* Identify design issues and field\-level problems and provide feedback to R\&D/product\-development teams.

3\. Required Technical Skills

RF Engineering

* Strong understanding of RF fundamentals and wireless communication systems.
* Knowledge of RF propagation, antennas, transmission lines and RF link budgets.
* Understanding of frequency, bandwidth, modulation, power levels, sensitivity, noise and interference.
* Ability to interpret RF measurements and analyse spectrum plots.

RF Detection

* Practical knowledge of RF signal detection, spectrum monitoring, RF signal identification, direction\-finding concepts,

signal\-strength measurement, RF interference analysis and detection\-range testing.

RF Jamming

* Knowledge of RF jamming principles, GNSS jamming concepts, RF interference/denial, jamming\-effectiveness

evaluation, frequency coverage, power requirements and antenna systems.

Anti\-Drone / Counter\-UAS

* Understanding of RF\-based drone detection and identification, RF jamming/mitigation, GNSS\-based drone navigation

concepts and Counter\-UAS system architecture.

4\. Test Equipment Knowledge

Candidates should be comfortable operating or learning to operate: Spectrum Analyzer, RF Signal Generator, RF

Power Meter, Vector Network Analyzer (VNA), Oscilloscope, Multimeter, Frequency Counter, VSWR/Return Loss

Measurement Equipment, RF Attenuators, Couplers, Loads, Directional Antennas, RF Cables and Connectors.

5\. Qualification

Essential: B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma in Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Electronics Engineering, RF/Microwave

Engineering, Telecommunications or Electrical \& Electronics Engineering.

Preferred: Experience in Defence Electronics, RF Systems, Electronic Warfare, Counter\-UAS, RF Surveillance,

Spectrum Monitoring, RF Detection or Jamming Systems.

6\. Experience

Preferred Experience: 3–8 Years.

Candidates with hands\-on experience in RF Detection Systems, RF Jamming Systems, Anti\-Drone / Counter\-UAS

Systems, GNSS Detection/Jamming Systems, RF Surveillance, Electronic Warfare Systems, Spectrum Monitoring, RF

Communication Systems, Defence Electronics, RF Test \& Measurement, or Antenna Testing and RF Integration will be

strongly preferred.

Candidates who have participated in field trials, customer installations and troubleshooting of RF systems will be given

preference over candidates with only theoretical RF knowledge.

7\. Behavioural \& Field Skills

* Strong hands\-on troubleshooting ability.
* Ability to work independently at customer and field locations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work under pressure during field trials and demonstrations.
* Good communication and customer\-interaction skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India and, if required, internationally.
* Ability to prepare clear and technically accurate test reports.
* Ability to coordinate with R\&D, production, quality and project teams.
* Good documentation and reporting discipline.

8\. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with RF detection and/or jamming equipment and understand

how such systems behave in real\-world environments.

Preference will be given to candidates who have previously worked on: RF Detector → RF Detection → Signal Analysis

→ RF Jamming → GNSS Jamming → Anti\-Drone / Counter\-UAS → Field Trials → Customer Installation →

Troubleshooting.

Candidates should be capable of independently carrying out a site visit, understanding the RF environment, setting up

test equipment, conducting tests, identifying faults and reporting results to the engineering team.

9\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Successful installation and commissioning of field systems.
* Timely completion of field trials and customer demonstrations.
* Accuracy and completeness of test reports.
* Effective troubleshooting and reduction of repeat field failures.
* Successful resolution of customer\-site technical issues.
* Compliance with approved test procedures and safety requirements.
* Quality of technical feedback provided to R\&D and engineering teams.
* Customer satisfaction during installation and field support.
